verdict.rationale: Cline's customization docs describe Skills as modular instruction sets that extend the agent for specific tasks. Each skill packages guidance, processes and optional resources, and Cline loads it only when relevant. This directly matches equipping the agent with custom skills for specialized work. Missing for 10: documented detail on how developers author and install their own skills (format, location, sharing), and independent or hands-on corroboration that skills work as described.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks
